definitions.explanation: a body type characterized by being thin or lean, as a natural physical constitution

examples.japanese: やせ{形|がた}の{人|ひと}は{冬|ふゆ}に{寒|さむ}さを{感|かん}じやすい。
examples.english: People with a thin build tend to feel the cold more in winter.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}はやせ{形|がた}で、{食|た}べても{太|ふと}らない{体質|たいしつ}だ。
examples.english: My mother has a slender build and a constitution where she doesn't gain weight even when she eats.

notes:
A compound of やせ (thin, from {痩|や}せる) and {形|がた} (type, build). Describes a person's natural body constitution rather than a temporary state of thinness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やせ{形|がた}の{人|ひと}: a person with a thin build
- やせ{形|がた}の{体型|たいけい}: a slender body type

RELATED BODY TYPE TERMS:
- {太|ふと}り{形|がた}: heavy-set build, stout body type
- {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうぜい}: average build and height
- がっしり{形|がた}: sturdy, solid build
- {小柄|こがら}: small-framed, petite

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {痩|や}せ{型|がた}: same word written with the kanji for やせ
- スリム: slim — a loanword, often used as a compliment
- ほっそり: slender — an adverb/adjective describing a graceful thinness
